result.summary: This PR sets CMake policies CMP0156 and CMP0179 to NEW, gated on CMake >=3.31, to de-duplicate libraries on link lines and silence Apple linker 'ignoring duplicate libraries' warnings. It also updates the macOS Guix build scripts to add -Wl,-fatal_warnings, turning those linker warnings into errors, consistent with other platforms. This is a rework of a previously closed PR (#31504) with updated rationale.
result.problem: Apple's linker emits 'ignoring duplicate libraries' warnings during macOS builds, which is noisy and currently prevents extending the existing warnings-as-errors policy (used on other platforms) to Darwin builds in Guix.

resolved_concerns: fanquake asked what changed since #31504 and why fatal_warnings wasn't added directly; hebasto explained CMake behavior stabilized (3.31+ needed) and added the -fatal_warnings change in a follow-up push, verified with Guix builds.

result.card: This PR sets CMake's CMP0156/CMP0179 policies to NEW to de-duplicate libraries on link lines, silencing Apple linker 'ignoring duplicate libraries' warnings, and updates the macOS Guix build scripts to add -Wl,-fatal_warnings, matching the warnings-as-errors treatment already used for other platforms. The stated motivation is that these warnings currently block extending strict linker-warning enforcement to Darwin builds in Guix. It is a rework of a previously closed PR (#31504) with a firmer rationale and CMake-version gating to avoid intermediate 3.29/3.30 behavior. The sole reviewer (fanquake) asked clarifying questions, which the author (hebasto) answered fully, implementing the requested fatal_warnings change and verifying with reproducible Guix build hashes. Reviewability is Ready and Agreement is Positive with no outstanding objections. Priority is modest (P3 in build): it removes a cosmetic warning and unblocks a follow-on CI hardening step, but no platform is currently broken.
